g.text: U4 monitors the cell; opposing Q3 MOSFETs interrupt its return during faults.

g.desc: U4 monitors the cell; opposing Q3 MOSFETs interrupt its return during faults.

g.text: OFF: R16*C29 = 10us. Small C prioritizes safe discharge, not 5s report filtering.

g.desc: OFF: R16*C29 = 10us. Small C prioritizes safe discharge, not 5s report filtering.

g.text: U3: constant-current then constant-voltage charge. C3 input / C4 battery bypass.

g.desc: U3: constant-current then constant-voltage charge. C3 input / C4 battery bypass.

g.text: U5 reuses the owned linear regulator; C7/C10 support input/output transients.

g.desc: U5 reuses the owned linear regulator; C7/C10 support input/output transients.

g.text: This is brief charge support, not guaranteed brownout prevention; DC bias lowers C.

g.desc: This is brief charge support, not guaranteed brownout prevention; DC bias lowers C.

g.text: Verify rail sag + temperature. A 600 mA rating is not an enclosed thermal guarantee.

g.desc: Verify rail sag + temperature. A 600 mA rating is not an enclosed thermal guarantee.

g.text: R30 initially DNP. Fit after cell/polarity/rating checks; verify charge and heat.

g.desc: R30 initially DNP. Fit after cell/polarity/rating checks; verify charge and heat.

g.text: D1 clamps fast ESD; C1/C2 locally bypass VBUS. Keep the ESD return short.

g.desc: D1 clamps fast ESD; C1/C2 locally bypass VBUS. Keep the ESD return short.

g.text: R1/R2 5.1k: USB-C sink detection in either orientation; no USB-PD negotiation.

g.desc: R1/R2 5.1k: USB-C sink detection in either orientation; no USB-PD negotiation.

g.text: J2 firmware uses calibrated mV x4 + averaging/EMA. Verify actual rail transitions.

g.desc: J2 firmware uses calibrated mV x4 + averaging/EMA. Verify actual rail transitions.

g.text: R4/C5: tau = 100R x 100nF = 10 us; ideal fc = 1/(2*pi*RC) = 15.9 kHz.

g.desc: R4/C5: tau = 100R x 100nF = 10 us; ideal fc = 1/(2*pi*RC) = 15.9 kHz.

g.text: R5 is the sense-input resistor. B_MINUS != GND: do not bypass Q3.

g.desc: R5 is the sense-input resistor. B_MINUS != GND: do not bypass Q3.

g.text: Power: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Data: D1 -> R38/R39 -> GPIO19/20 (sheet 4).

g.desc: Power: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Data: D1 -> R38/R39 -> GPIO19/20 (sheet 4).

g.text: USB: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Battery: B_PLUS -> Q1 -> SYS_IN.

g.desc: USB: VBUS -> D2 -> SYS_IN. Battery: B_PLUS -> Q1 -> SYS_IN.

g.text: R6 pulls Q1 gate low without USB; USB raises its gate to isolate the cell path.

g.desc: R6 pulls Q1 gate low without USB; USB raises its gate to isolate the cell path.

g.text: SW1 ON grounds LED_GATE; OFF grounds SYS_EN. R7/R41 are pull-ups.

g.desc: SW1 ON grounds LED_GATE; OFF grounds SYS_EN. R7/R41 are pull-ups.

g.text: Contacts carry control current only: 4.2 V / 100k = 42 uA per grounded pull-up.

g.desc: Contacts carry control current only: 4.2 V / 100k = 42 uA per grounded pull-up.

g.text: OFF disables loads; charging/protection are still connected. Q5/R41: sheet 4.

g.desc: OFF disables loads; charging/protection are still connected. Q5/R41: sheet 4.

g.text: VADC = VBAT*10/(30+10) = VBAT/4; 4.2 V -> 1.05 V; divider current 105 uA.

g.desc: VADC = VBAT*10/(30+10) = VBAT/4; 4.2 V -> 1.05 V; divider current 105 uA.

g.text: Q4 blocks cell-to-ADC drive when +3V3 is off. R16 discharges the node.

g.desc: Q4 blocks cell-to-ADC drive when +3V3 is off. R16 discharges the node.
